cues.title: Act 1 · The Listening Ear
cues.text: On the night of August 15, 1977, deep in the Ohio countryside, a football-field-sized radio telescope known as Big Ear was silently listening to the cosmos.

cues.title: Act 1 · Project SETI
cues.text: Humanity had just launched Project SETI: searching fifty channels simultaneously for a deliberate artificial broadcast from an alien civilization.

cues.title: Act 2 · Earth's Rotation Window
cues.text: Big Ear was completely immobile. It had no steering motors, relying entirely on the Earth's rotation to sweep across the starry sky.

cues.title: Act 2 · The 72-Second Bell Curve
cues.text: Because of its beam width, any genuine point source from deep space could only be heard for exactly seventy-two seconds, rising and falling in a textbook bell curve.

cues.title: Act 3 · The Mainframe Printout
cues.text: A few days later, astronomer Jerry Ehman arrived to review stacks of tractor-feed paper from the IBM 1130 mainframe.

cues.title: Act 3 · The 6EQUJ5 Surge
cues.text: Amidst the random background noise of ones and twos, channel two suddenly spiked into letters: six, E, Q, U, J, five. A signal thirty times stronger than deep space background radiation.

cues.title: Act 3 · The Hydrogen Line
cues.text: Even more astonishing, it was broadcasting at 1420.405 megahertz: the exact emission frequency of neutral hydrogen, the cosmic waterhole where alien civilizations would theoretically transmit.

cues.title: Act 4 · The Red Pen & The 'Wow!'
cues.text: Stunned, Jerry grabbed a red Pilot pen, circled the six characters, and scribbled a single word in the margin: Wow!

cues.title: Act 4 · Failed Hypotheses
cues.text: For nearly half a century, astronomers tested every terrestrial explanation: classified military satellites, aircraft reflections, passing comets. Every single hypothesis failed.

cues.title: Act 5 · The Silent Void
cues.text: The Very Large Array and Green Bank telescopes returned to those exact coordinates near Chi Sagittarii over a hundred times. The patch of sky was dead silent.

cues.title: Act 5 · Cosmic Whisper
cues.text: A solitary seventy-two-second transmission, broadcast across thousands of light-years, never to be heard again.

cues.title: Outro · Investigation Unsolved
cues.text: The greatest unsolved mystery in the history of deep space astronomy. The Wow! Signal.
